answer: He ran fifty fresh identities that vouched for each other. The first client split proof like a prism. The work went to one witness, the timing to another, so no accomplice could light the whole record. Each fake had to show a chain where every cipher sealed the job before it, one slow job at a time. Fifty slow climbs before any charged full price, and the operator quit on day three. The ivory ledger kept the attempt on file. Honest newcomers climb the same steps.
